CHI.head: A slightly uphill night for Chicago
CHI.body: Winnipeg has controlled the play far better over recent games and Chicago has home ice. Chicago can tip it if it keeps the shots to the outside.

WPG.head: Winnipeg starts a half-step ahead
WPG.body: Winnipeg has controlled the play far better over recent games and Chicago has home ice. Chicago can still swing it if it keeps the shots to the outside.
